notes.title: 【Steam Achievements Live】Call of Boba's Achievement Dev Milestone is finished!
notes.notes:
[p]Dear Players:[/p][p]We are deeply sorry to have kept you waiting! This update not only brings the highly anticipated new achievement system but also fixes a critical issue that was severely impacting the gameplay experience, as we strive to ensure your journey through the game is a smooth one.[/p][p][/p][p]First, the much-awaited Steam Achievement system is now officially live! We have meticulously designed an initial set of 44 achievements, aiming to provide new goals and challenges for your exploration in Moso Town. From managing your shop to delving deep into the dream world, every precious footstep you take will be recorded. Come and unlock your well-deserved honors![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807841/8c3ca5552f2de1a96a34919e2c69e4859191ef8f.png"][/img][/p][p]At the same time, we have implemented an emergency fix for a critical issue reported by the community: we have corrected a bug that could cause the final boss of the first level to incorrectly trigger as a "work-in-progress Frog Boss." We offer our sincerest apologies for any trouble this may have caused. Please also rest assured that this mysterious "new friend" will officially meet you all in a more complete and formidable state in a future update![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807841/67b863089e46f865e8387918492edec94da624a5.gif"][/img][/p][p]Furthermore, to make the town feel more alive and vibrant, we have added more character schedule dialogues and fixed several bugs and errors related to NPC routines, allowing the residents' movements to be more natural and fluid.[/p][p][/p][p]Looking ahead, we will continue to work tirelessly, delivering more exciting content and detailed optimizations based on your feedback. The story of the town is to be continued, so please stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p][b]Notice:[/b] The gifting system is temporarily closed for maintenance. We will be introducing a more complex gifting system with enhanced dialogue feedback in the next version! It is temporarily deactivated for development reasons. Thank you for your understanding!

If you encounter any bugs during gameplay, please report them to us immediately. We will fix them and release updates promptly.

notes.title: 【Massive NPC Dynamics & Environmental Sound effects Added】May 30th Update
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We're truly sorry to have kept you all waiting! We've poured a great deal of effort into polishing this update, striving to bring you an even better gaming experience.

Firstly, the lives of our town residents have become much more vibrant and varied! We've meticulously designed more diverse daily routines for our existing residents. Now, they will display distinctly different schedules based on the day of the week and weather conditions, accompanied by a massive amount of new, unique dialogue, making daily life in town even more full of surprises.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807841/ce6c27bd15506f34710c2214081b2afcc9332abe.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807841/4bf3a01ae5bb80a09be185cb6478858c36384124.gif[/img]

At the same time, our bustling town welcomes two new friends—Pippa and Maisie! We hope you'll enjoy meeting them in the game and unlocking heartwarming new stories together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807841/c9f2bf244b2411d7641b850ad1d02d83381bfb46.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807841/12a1acf0212c829e942dff0bf97628ae7f914ca4.png[/img]

In terms of auditory experience, we've also implemented a comprehensive upgrade: we've added ambient sound effects for scenes like campfires, waterfalls, and streams, as well as nuanced environmental sounds for different weather conditions such as rainy and windy days. These changes will significantly enhance your immersion and sense of realism within the game world.

Looking ahead, we won't stop here; we're committed to bringing you more exciting dialogues, richer content, and refined details in future updates. The story of our town is still unfolding—stay tuned!

Notice: The Gifting System is temporarily closed for maintenance. We are adding a more complex gifting system and dialogue feedback in the next version! It is currently disabled for development reasons. Thanks for your understanding!

If you encounter any bugs during gameplay, please report them to us immediately. We will fix them and release updates promptly.

notes.title: Statement Regarding the Early Access Launch of "Call of Boba"
notes.notes:
The Early Access version of "Call of Boba" is now live!

We'd like to extend our heartfelt thanks to all players, loyal fans who've long supported us, and testers who've provided invaluable feedback. Your encouragement and suggestions have been immensely helpful.

Below are updates regarding known issues and upcoming improvements. We sincerely appreciate your understanding and continued support!

Known Issues & Improvement Plans:

Controller Support:
We've promptly addressed reported controller issues with initial patches. Further enhancements for controller usability are underway. Additionally, we are developing customizable key-binding features to accommodate various player preferences.

UI Optimization:
We're currently redesigning the UI and display elements for better visual clarity and improved user experience.

Minimizing Window Stability:
We're aware of display alignment issues after minimizing and returning to the game. Testing is ongoing to ensure stability across different resolutions. Once confirmed stable, this fix will be included in the game build.

Game Saving Functionality:
The game currently auto-saves only at night when players sleep. Due to player requests, we're prioritizing the implementation of manual saving functionality and aim to release it as soon as possible.

Once again, thank you for your patience and valuable feedback!


Feedback & Bug Reporting:

Join in our [url=https://t.co/YCKVyN4uqs]Discord Server Here:[/url]

notes.title: Steam Demo Fest Success + Updates!
notes.notes:
Hey Baristas and Fledglings,

We’re beyond excited to share that Call of Boba had an incredible turnout during Steam Demo Fest! Your enthusiasm, feedback, and support truly blew us away. It’s amazing to see so many of you enjoying our cozy little game 🥹 

A Huge Thank You!
First off, we want to say a huge thank you to everyone who played the demo and provided feedback. Whether you were making the best Boba ever or plundering dungeons, your comments and feedback is helping us make the game the best it can be! 

Key Changes and Fixes (Based on Your Feedback!)
We’ve listened closely to your feedback and have made some exciting improvements to the game! Check out the list of fixes and updates we’ve implemented ( live right now in the steam demo version!) to make your experience even smoother and more fun:

Bug Fixes

1) Save Bug Fixed: The game no longer crashes when you interact with the PC in Bobo’s room. (No more blue screens of death for poor Bobo) 

2) Text Box Fixes: Sentences are no longer cut in half, and text stays inside the box. Smooth reading!

4) Capy and Bobo’s Dialogue Sorted: They’ve finally remembered to say their own lines. We swear!

5) Stellar Glitch Fix: Stellar won’t freak out if you give them gifts. Maybe they were just too flabbergasted by your generosity before. 😅

6) Flower Petal Stacking: We fixed the issue where flower petals would not stack properly.

7)Mouse Speed Glitch: Resolved the issue where the mouse would randomly become extremely slow during gameplay.


Quality of life Improvements

1) Customer Wait Times Extended: You’ll have more time to serve drinks without rushing—no more boba chaos (unless you want it!).

2) Mouse Click to Skip Dialogue: You can now click to skip through dialogue (except for the tutorial and intro cutscenes—still working on that!).

3) New Foraging Options: Starting from day 2, you can gather new forage-able plants throughout the map. 

4) Faster Fishing Minigame: The fishing minigame now takes less time, so you can reel in those catches faster!

5) Select Your Menu UI: We improved the UI by adding two icons to make the process more intuitive, and updated the key instructions to make them clearer and easier to understand.

6) Item/Drink Selection: A blinking effect has been added to indicate when you select different quantities of items and drinks.

User Interface (UI) & Visual Updates

1) UI Cleanup: The WASD UI has been removed from the shop menu so it no longer covers the money counter.

2) Lighting Improvements: We’ve removed the blurry pixel effect in some scenes and backgrounds, making everything clearer and sharper.

3) Updated Title Screen Music: We’ve refreshed the title screen with new music to better set the tone.

4) Flowery Cutscene Effects: Beautiful flowery effects now appear during certain cutscenes, adding a touch of magic and whimsy to your experience~

Translation and Dialogue Improvements

1) Typos and Punctuation: Fixed unnecessary “?”s at the end of sentences and other minor typos.

2) Translation Improvements: While still a bit quirky, we’ve tackled many translation errors and will continue to refine the English text.

Sound and Audio

1) More Sound Effects: We’ve added more sound effects throughout the game to enhance immersion.

2) Updated Title Screen Music: Fresh new music to set the mood when you start the game.

What's Next?

As we continue to build and refine Call of Boba, we’re focusing on bringing you even more lore, more exciting gameplay elements, and more opportunities to dive into the world we’ve created. We’re working hard to improve the experience based on your feedback, so keep it coming!

Thank you for being a part of this journey with us. 

Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, stay frothy Fledglings!

Much love,
The Call of Boba Team

notes.title: DEV LOG #01
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, It has been a long time since we updated our progress! Let's take a look at the recent changes！

[h2]1️⃣New Features[/h2]

[h3]🎒Backpack + Map System
[/h3]
We have developed and improved the backpack and map systems. Players can view and check their tools by opening the item page in the main menu. Players can drag the mini-map to view their destination on the map page. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807841/a1b9df3e2e64f7e095c58039a1781da0428e88a9.gif[/img]

[h3]🛋"Decorate Room" Feature[/h3]

We have updated the furniture placement system in the milk tea shop. Players can buy tables or chairs to decorate the shop. The new tables and chairs can attract customers and generate more profits. Try to make more money and buy as much furniture as you can! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807841/bba2381a7b0558d4d2421295474c880e121a003e.gif[/img]

[h2]2️⃣Seasons and Weather System[/h2]

We just finished the seasons and weather system. Players can experience fun weather effects like rain, falling leaves, and snow. They can also perceive the changes in seasons through environmental transformations. Tapioca Town is becoming a wonderful cozy place for living!

🌧Mystery house in the rain

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807841/a788430b78066d5e5675d9df9be6707e0d0effec.gif[/img]

🍂Falling Autumn leaves

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807841/a2465c3c230d1d5332b67e9491862abcbbfad079.gif[/img]

❄️Winter Lake

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807841/89f19ad6a00d715327fd99273e9463f0e40ab3b5.gif[/img]

[h2]3️⃣A new area has been added[/h2]

A new area has been added—the Community Activity Center. We have also added facilities such as Tapioca Town Fountain Square, the Hero Statue, and the Town Notice Board in this area. New NPCs and dialogues have also been completed!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807841/f9ffeb0934836f7f4cb03ec747695f53b694df22.gif[/img]

[h2]4️⃣Fixed known bugs[/h2]

Resolved issues related to game crashes and interface display problems in the playtest, enhancing the game's stability.

Next, we will focus on completing the remaining development work. Thank you all for your support and feedback. We will continue to work hard to bring more exciting content to Call of Boba!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

⭐️[b]Stay tuned for more updates, and feel free to join our community for fun and discussions![/b]

notes.title: OFFICIALLY REVEALING ‘CALL OF BOBA’!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! It’s the day you’ve finally been waiting for: the official reveal of ‘Call of Boba’! Feast your penguin eyes on the trailer below! :-) 

In ‘Call of Boba’, you play as corporate runaway Boba on a quest to save his hometown’s struggling boba tea shop. It’s a cozy adventure game where you manage the business, brew tea, find recipes, plant and farm ingredients, befriend (and fall in love!) with customers, fight dream enemies with Boba weapons, explore, go fishing, and more on your quest to serve up the best tea in town!

Ready to dive into our Boba life?

Let us know what you think. <3 The Tomatoast team has been hard at work, and we’re all very excited to put this game in your hands!
